title: Correcting the Logic Behind the 2026 US Vehicle Emissions Standard Rollback
The Efficiency of Dynamic Electricity Pricing Schemes
Global Policy Spillovers: Evidence from the Multinational Autombile Industry
The Trouble with Green Subsidies
abstract: This paper explores the efficiency consequences of pursuing pollution reduction through reliance on green subsidies rather than pollution taxes. It presents a stylized model of “subsidy-first” policy in which subsidies are rationalized by missing or incomplete taxes on some goods. It delineates five sources of inefficiency in subsidies, several of which relate to information requirements. In the model, green subsidies are justified because they induce substitution away from dirtier alternatives. Thus, subsidies hinge on counterfactuals, which creates information challenges analogous to the additionality problem. Insights from the model are used to comment on the Inflation Reduction Act.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了通过依赖绿色补贴而非污染税来实现减污，所带来的效率后果。文章提出了一个“补贴优先”政策的程式化模型，在该模型中，补贴的合理性源于某些商品上缺失或不完整的税收。文章划分了补贴中的五种低效来源，其中若干与信息需求有关。在该模型中，绿色补贴之所以合理，是因为它们诱导人们转向更为污染的替代品。因此，补贴取决于反事实情形，这带来了与额外性问题类似的信息挑战。本文利用模型得出的洞见，对《通胀削减法案》作出了评论。

title: Retiring Old Capital to Foster Decarbonization
venue: Entrepreneurship and Innovation Policy and the Economy
abstract: A majority of anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions come from fossil fuel combustion. Combustion nearly always involves some form of durable capital, which includes vehicles, appliances, and power generators. Many policies aim to improve environmental outcomes by regulating the efficiency or emissions of this capital. Most such policies focus on new capital. This paper discusses the importance of policies that target used capital as a complement to such regulations. In particular, the paper argues that used capital policies that are designed to accelerate retirement of used capital, by either taxing its use or subsidizing its scrappage, can have efficiency benefits by addressing unintended consequences of policies that target new capital. The paper also argues that retirement subsidies are likely to be a relatively progressive policy instrument as compared with alternatives. Policy makers should understand the role that such policies might play in fostering equitable decarbonization of the economy.
abstract_zh: 人为温室气体排放的大部分来自化石燃料燃烧。燃烧几乎总是涉及某种形式的耐用资本，包括车辆、家用电器和发电机组。许多政策旨在通过监管这些资本的效率或排放来改善环境结果。此类政策大多聚焦于新资本。本文讨论了以二手资本为目标的政策作为此类监管补充的重要性。特别是，本文认为，旨在通过对二手资本的使用征税或对其报废给予补贴来加速其退役的二手资本政策，可以通过弥补针对新资本的政策所产生的非预期后果而带来效率收益。本文还认为，与其他替代工具相比，退役补贴可能是一种相对更具累进性的政策工具。政策制定者应当理解此类政策在促进经济公平脱碳方面可能发挥的作用。

title: Regulating Untaxable Externalities: Are Vehicle Air Pollution Standards Effective and Efficient?
abstract: The world has 1.4 billion passenger vehicles. How should governments regulate their air pollution emissions? A Pigouvian tax is technologically infeasible. Most countries instead rely on exhaust standards that limit air pollution emissions per mile for new vehicles. We assess the effectiveness and efficiency of these standards, which are the centerpiece of US Clean Air Act regulation of transportation, and counterfactual policies. We show that the air pollution emissions per mile of new US vehicles has fallen spectacularly, by over 99 percent, since standards began in 1967. Several research designs with a half century of data suggest that exhaust standards have caused most of this decline. Yet exhaust standards are not cost-effective in part because they fail to encourage scrap of older vehicles, which account for the majority of emissions. To study counterfactual policies, we develop an analytical and a quantitative model of the vehicle fleet. Analysis of these models suggests that tighter exhaust standards increase social welfare and that increasing registration fees on dirty vehicles yields even larger gains by accelerating scrap, though both reforms have complex effects on inequality.
abstract_zh: 全球有14亿辆乘用车。政府应如何监管其空气污染排放？庇古税在技术上不可行。大多数国家转而依赖尾气标准，即限制新车每英里的空气污染排放量。我们评估了这些标准的有效性和效率，它们是美国《清洁空气法》对交通运输实施监管的核心，同时也评估了若干反事实政策。我们表明，自1967年标准实施以来，美国新车每英里的空气污染排放量已大幅下降，降幅超过99%。利用半个世纪数据的若干研究设计表明，尾气标准是这一下降的主要原因。然而，尾气标准并不具备成本效益，部分原因在于它未能激励淘汰老旧车辆，而老旧车辆贡献了大部分排放。为研究反事实政策，我们构建了车队的解析模型和定量模型。对这些模型的分析表明，更严格的尾气标准会提高社会福利；而提高高排放车辆的登记费，则可通过加速报废带来更大的收益，尽管这两项改革对不平等都有复杂的影响。

title: Pigou Create Losers: On the Implausibility of Achieving Pareto Improvements from Corrective Taxation
Who Benefits When Firms Game Corrective Policies?
Should Electric Vehicle Drivers Pay a Mileage Tax?
abstract: In many countries, the revenue from gasoline taxes is used to fund highways and other transportation infrastructure. As the number of electric vehicles on the road increases, this raises questions about the effectiveness and equity of this financing mechanism. In this paper, we ask whether electric vehicle drivers should pay a mileage tax. Though the gasoline tax has been traditionally viewed as a benefits tax, we instead take the perspective of economic efficiency. We derive a condition for the optimal electric vehicle mileage tax that highlights a key trade-off. On the one hand, there are externalities from driving, including traffic congestion and accidents, that imply a mileage tax is efficient. On the other hand, gasoline tends to be underpriced, so a low (or even negative) mileage tax might have efficiency benefits in encouraging substitution away from gasoline-powered vehicles. We then turn to an empirical analysis aimed at better understanding the current policy landscape for electric vehicles in the United States. Using newly available, nationally representative microdata, we calculate that electric vehicles have reduced gasoline tax revenues by $250 million annually. We show that the forgone tax revenue is highly concentrated in a handful of states and is highly regressive, as most electric vehicles are driven by high-income households, and we discuss how this motivates and informs optimal policy.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，汽油税的收入用于资助公路及其他交通基础设施建设。随着道路上电动汽车数量的增加，这一融资机制的有效性与公平性引发了疑问。本文探讨电动汽车驾驶人是否应当缴纳里程税。尽管汽油税传统上被视为一种受益税，我们则从经济效率的角度出发。我们推导了最优电动汽车里程税的条件，该条件凸显了一个关键的权衡。一方面，驾驶带来的外部性，包括交通拥堵和事故，意味着里程税具有效率。另一方面，汽油价格往往被低估，因此较低（甚至为负）的里程税可能通过鼓励人们转向汽油动力车辆之外而具有效率收益。随后，我们转向实证分析，旨在更好地理解美国当前电动汽车的政策格局。利用新近可得的、具有全国代表性的微观数据，我们计算出电动汽车每年使汽油税收入减少了2.5亿美元。我们表明，损失的税收高度集中于少数几个州，并且具有强烈的累退性，因为大多数电动汽车由高收入家庭驾驶；我们还讨论了这一情况如何推动并指导最优政策的制定。

title: The Use of Regression Statistics to Analyze Imperfect Pricing Policies
Flawed Analyses of U.S. Auto Fuel Economy Standards
The Economics of Attribute-Based Regulation: Theory and Evidence from Fuel-Economy Standards
abstract: In many countries, fuel-economy standards mandate that vehicles meet a certain fuel economy, but heavier or larger vehicles are allowed to meet a lower standard. This has the perverse implication of allowing automakers to meet standards either by improving fuel economy or by increasing weight, which lowers fuel economy and increases externalities related to accidents. This is but one example of an attribute-based regulation, in which the subsidy, tax or regulation imposed on a product is a function not just of the amount of an externality that the product generates, but also how each product’s externality compares to that of other products deemed to be similar by virtue of a commonality in some other attribute. Such policies are ubiquitous, but the core logic and welfare consequences of their deployment have not been studied by academic economists. This paper develops an analytical framework that captures the central implications of attribute-based policies, characterizes the deadweight loss caused by attribute-basing, and establishes situations in which attribute-basing may be efficient. The paper then empirically examines the consequences of attribute-based fuel economy standards in Japan, where fuel economy standards are an attribute-based function of vehicle weight. We use cross-sectional and panel techniques to demonstrate that attribute-based regulation has significantly altered the distribution of vehicle weight in Japan. We estimate that this alteration generates a welfare loss on the order of $200 per car sold in Japan, which translates into a $1 billion annual loss.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，燃油经济性标准要求车辆达到一定的燃油经济性，但较重或较大的车辆可以达到较低的标准。这带来了一个反常的结果：汽车制造商既可以通过提高燃油经济性来达标，也可以通过增加车重来达标，而后者会降低燃油经济性并增加与事故相关的外部性。这只是基于属性的监管的一个例子，在此类监管中，施加于某一产品的补贴、税收或监管，不仅取决于该产品所产生的外部性数量，还取决于该产品的外部性与其他因某些共同属性而被视为相似的产品相比如何。此类政策无处不在，但其核心逻辑及其实施的福利后果一直未受到经济学学者的研究。本文构建了一个分析框架，以刻画基于属性政策的核心含义，刻画由基于属性所造成的无谓损失，并确定基于属性可能具有效率的情形。随后，本文以日本为例进行了实证检验，日本的燃油经济性标准是车辆重量的基于属性函数。我们运用截面和面板方法证明，基于属性的监管显著改变了日本的车重分布。我们估计，这种改变造成的福利损失约为日本每辆售出汽车200美元的量级，换算成每年约为10亿美元的损失。

title: Tax Incidence with Endogenous Quality and Costly Bargaining: Theory and Evidence from Hybrid Vehicle Sales
Who Loses when Prices are Negotiated? An Analysis of the New Car Market
Designing Policies to Make Cars Greener: A Review of the Literature
Do Consumers Recognize the Value of Fuel Economy? Evidence from Used Car Prices and Gasoline Price Fluctuations
abstract: Debate about the appropriate design of energy policy hinges critically on whether consumers might undervalue energy efficiency, due to myopia or some other manifestation of limited rationality. We contribute to this debate by measuring consumers' willingness to pay for fuel economy using a novel identification strategy and high quality microdata from wholesale used car auctions. We leverage differences in future fuel costs across otherwise identical vehicles that have different current mileage, and therefore different remaining lifetimes. By seeing how price differences across high and low mileage vehicles of different fuel economies change in response to shocks to the price of gasoline, we estimate the relationship between vehicle prices and future fuel costs. Our data suggest that used automobile prices move one for one with changes in present discounted future fuel costs, which implies that consumers fully value fuel economy.
abstract_zh: 关于能源政策应当如何设计的争论，关键取决于消费者是否可能因短视或有限理性的其他表现形式而低估能源效率。我们通过采用一种新颖的识别策略，并利用来自批发二手车拍卖的高质量微观数据，测量消费者为燃油经济性支付的意愿，从而为这一争论作出贡献。我们利用了当前行驶里程不同、因而剩余使用寿命不同的其他方面相同车辆在未来燃料成本上的差异。通过观察在汽油价格冲击下，不同燃油经济性的高里程与低里程车辆之间的价格差异如何变化，我们估计了车辆价格与未来燃料成本之间的关系。我们的数据表明，二手汽车价格随着未来燃料成本的贴现现值变化而等比例变动，这意味着消费者充分重视燃油经济性。

title: New Evidence on Taxes and the Timing of Birth
The Intergenerational Transmission of Automobile Brand Preferences: Empirical Evidence and Implications for Firm Strategy
Rational Inattention and Energy Efficiency
abstract: This paper argues that it will often be rational for consumers to pay limited attention to energy efficiency when choosing among energy-consuming durable goods like automobiles or home appliances. The reason is that the proper valuation of energy efficiency requires time and effort, but differences in efficiency across products will rarely be pivotal to choice when consumers have strong preferences regarding other product attributes. The paper first explains why proper valuation of efficiency is difficult, even in the presence of government energy labels. It next develops a model that shows how to value additional information about energy efficiency in a discrete-choice context. It then uses data on automobiles to show that consumers experience only small welfare losses when forced to choose a car without detailed information about fuel costs. Finally, the paper discusses the implications of rational inattention for both economic research and public policy.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，在选择汽车或家用电器等耗能耐用品时，消费者有限关注能源效率往往是理性的。原因在于，对能源效率进行恰当估值需要时间和精力，而当消费者对其他产品属性有强烈偏好时，产品之间的效率差异很少会对其选择起决定性作用。本文首先解释了即使在政府能源标签存在的情况下，对效率进行恰当估值为何也十分困难。接着，本文构建了一个模型，展示了如何在离散选择背景下评估关于能源效率的额外信息的价值。随后，本文利用汽车数据表明，当消费者被迫在缺乏详细燃料成本信息的情况下选车时，其福利损失很小。最后，本文讨论了理性关注不足对经济学研究和公共政策的含义。

title: The Value of Honesty: Empirical Evidence from the Case of the Missing Children
What Do Consumers Believe About Future Gasoline Prices?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: A full understanding of how gasoline prices affect consumer behavior frequently requires information on how consumers forecast future gasoline prices. We provide the first evidence on the nature of these forecasts by analyzing two decades of data on gasoline price expectations from the Michigan Survey of Consumers. We find that average consumer beliefs are typically indistinguishable from a no-change forecast, justifying an assumption commonly made in the literature on consumer valuation of energy efficiency. We also provide evidence on circumstances in which consumer forecasts are likely to deviate from no-change and on significant cross-consumer forecast heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 要全面理解汽油价格如何影响消费者行为，往往需要了解消费者如何预测未来的汽油价格。我们通过分析密歇根消费者调查二十年来的汽油价格预期数据，首次提供了关于这些预测性质的证据。我们发现，消费者的平均信念通常与不变预测（no-change forecast）无法区分，这为文献中关于消费者对能源效率估价的常见假设提供了依据。我们还提供了证据，说明消费者预测在哪些情形下可能偏离不变预测，以及消费者之间预测存在显著异质性。

title: Car Notches: Strategic Automaker Responses to Fuel Economy Policy
abstract: Notches ---where small changes in behavior lead to large changes in a tax or subsidy ---figure prominently in many policies, but have been rarely examined by economists. In this paper, we analyze a class of notches associated with policies aimed at improving vehicle fuel economy. We provide several pieces of evidence showing that automakers respond to notches in fuel economy policy by precisely manipulating fuel economy ratings so as to just qualify for more favorable treatment. We then describe the welfare consequences of this behavior and derive a welfare summary statistic applicable to many contexts.
abstract_zh: “切口”（notch）——即行为的微小变化导致税收或补贴的大幅变化——在许多政策中都十分突出，但经济学家却很少对其加以研究。本文分析了一类与旨在提高车辆燃油经济性的政策相关的切口。我们提供了多项证据，表明汽车制造商会通过精确操纵燃油经济性评级，以恰好符合更有利待遇的条件，从而对燃油经济性政策中的切口作出反应。随后，我们描述了这种行为的福利后果，并推导出一个可适用于多种情境的福利综合统计量。

title: Financial Reporting, Tax, and Real Decisions: Toward a Unifying Framework
Forecasting Gasoline Prices Using Consumer Surveys
abstract: This paper analyzes the predictive power of a new data set of consumer gasoline price forecasts taken from the Michigan Survey of Consumers (MSC). MSC data generally perform as well as a no-change forecast in predicting future gasoline prices, and they substantially out-perform the no-change forecast during the recent economic crisis, during which time they track futures market prices. Finally, the cross-respondent dispersion of the MSC forecasts increases substantially during the economic crisis, paralleling the large increase in price volatility at this time.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了一组取自密歇根消费者调查（MSC）的新数据集中消费者汽油价格预测的预测能力。在预测未来汽油价格方面，MSC数据总体上与不变预测表现相当；而在近期的经济危机期间，它们显著优于不变预测，并且其走势与期货市场价格相吻合。最后，在经济危机期间，MSC预测在受访者之间的离散程度大幅上升，这与同期价格波动的大幅上升相呼应。

title: Fuel Economy Standards: Impacts, Efficiency, and Alternatives
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article discusses automobile fuel economy standards in the United States and other countries. We first describe how these programs affect the automobile market, including impacts on fuel consumption and other dimensions of the vehicle fleet. We then review two different methodologies for assessing the costs of fuel economy programs—engineering and market-based approaches—and discuss what the results of these assessments imply for policy. Next we compare the welfare effects of fuel economy standards and fuel taxes and discuss whether these two types of policies can be complementary. Finally, we review arguments for transitioning away from fuel economy regulations and toward a “feebate” system, a policy approach that imposes fees on vehicles that are fuel inefficient and provides rebates to those that are fuel efficient.
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了美国及其他国家的汽车燃油经济性标准。我们首先描述了这些计划如何影响汽车市场，包括对燃料消耗以及车队其他方面的影响。随后，我们回顾了评估燃油经济性计划成本的两种不同方法——工程方法和市场方法——并讨论这些评估结果对政策意味着什么。接着，我们比较了燃油经济性标准与燃油税的福利效应，并讨论这两类政策是否可以互补。最后，我们回顾了从燃油经济性监管转向“费率返还”（feebate）制度的理由，所谓费率返还制度是一种政策方法，即对燃油效率低的车辆征收费用，并对燃油效率高的车辆给予返还。

title: The Surprising Incidence of Tax Credits for the Toyota Prius
The Taxation of Fuel Economy
Using Loopholes to Reveal the Marginal Cost of Regulation: The Case of Fuel-Economy Standards
abstract: Estimating the cost of regulation is difficult. Firms sometimes reveal costs indirectly, however, when they exploit loopholes to avoid regulation. We apply this insight to fuel economy standards for automobiles. These standards feature a loophole that gives automakers a bonus when they equip a vehicle with flexible-fuel capacity. Profit-maximizing automakers will equate the marginal cost of compliance using the loophole, which is observable, with the unobservable costs of strategies that genuinely improve fuel economy. Based on this insight, we estimate that tightening standards by one mile per gallon would have cost automakers just $9–$27 per vehicle in recent years. (JEL L51, L62, Q48)
abstract_zh: 估计监管成本十分困难。然而，当企业利用漏洞规避监管时，有时会间接地揭示其成本。我们将这一洞见应用于汽车燃油经济性标准。这些标准设有一项漏洞，即当汽车制造商为车辆配备灵活燃料能力时，可获得奖励。追求利润最大化的汽车制造商会使利用该漏洞的合规边际成本（可观测）与真正提高燃油经济性的策略的不可观测成本相等。基于这一洞见，我们估计，近年来将标准提高每加仑1英里，对汽车制造商而言每辆车的成本仅为9至27美元。（JEL L51, L62, Q48）

title: A Cautionary Tale About the Use of Administrative Data: Evidence from Age of Marriage Laws
The Optimal Allocation of Students and Resources in a System of Higher Education
venue: The B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis & Policy (Advances Tier)
